title: Story premise EDU103: The Alert Has a Date Stamp
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (public safety/preparedness). Hook: Is this warning for this place and this time? Takeaway/theme: An alert’s source, location, time, and updates determine its relevance.
description: A resident wants to understand an urgent shared warning, but a cropped screenshot hides its location and date. Restoring those fields and checking the issuing authority prevents an old warning from being treated as a current instruction.
